title: Battle of Oshakan
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Oshakan", at revision 1371931615, opens: "The Battle of Oshakan was a battle that took place on 29 August 1827 during the Russo-Persian War (1826–1828) between the army of the heir to the Persian throne Abbas Mirza and the Russian detachment of Lieutenant General Afanasy Krasovsky." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4340762, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle of the 1826--1828 Russo-Persian War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
